node_naming.rule: Use intention-revealing names instead of node-type-only names.

chaining.retry_rule: Increment metadata.retry_count only when an actual retry is attempted.
chaining.source_rule: Downstream workflows replace source with their own workflow and node details.

activation.activation_rule: Activate only in the local n8n UI after credentials, timeouts and error branches have been reviewed.
activation.versioning_rule: Use the workflow name for human workflow versions and schema_version for envelope compatibility.

review_checklist: Workflow file path follows the repository naming convention.
Every node has an intention-revealing name.
No node contains hard-coded credentials, tokens, cookies or private Notion text.
API nodes have explicit timeout and bounded retry behavior.
Success path emits the standard success envelope.
Error path emits the standard error envelope.
Error context is minimal and masks sensitive values.
run_id and correlation_id are propagated unchanged across workflow calls.
Workflow remains inactive in exported JSON unless local validation is complete.
